body: In-scope correction decision after the first DM-809 run: deadline/actual-exit consumer plus 19 inherited cases passed, but exact-restoration resume failed. No unchanged rerun authorized to seek green. Git primary docs https://git-scm.com/docs/diff-config establish that diff.autoRefreshIndex ignores stat-only changes for porcelain git diff, not plumbing git diff-files. Therefore inherited diff-files --quiet was not a sufficient semantic-content fix; DM-807's passing observation did not prove the stronger c1 claim. It remains rejected/unintegrated. Authorized correction in DM-809: use a content-aware porcelain comparison with explicit stat-refresh behavior, unchanged read-only/staged-index protections and no external-diff/textconv/submodule masking, then verify the changed source. Assertion JSON diagnostics may improve the failure output without weakening expectations. This is the original exact-content invariant, not new scope or a retry/timeout waiver.
